manualTranslations.zh: 王環，鎮州真定人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Huan was a native of Zhending in Zhen prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Huan came from Zhending in Zhen.

manualTranslations.zh: 以勇力事孟知祥為御者，及知祥僭號于蜀，使典衞兵。
manualTranslations.literal: By courage and strength he served Meng Zhixiang as charioteer; when Zhixiang usurped the title in Shu, he had Huan command the guard troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By strength he served Meng Zhixiang as charioteer. When Zhixiang seized the title in Shu, he put Huan in charge of the guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉開運之亂，秦、鳳、階、成入于蜀，孟昶以環為鳳州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the disorder of Jin’s Kaiyun era, Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng fell to Shu; Meng Chang made Huan military commissioner of Feng prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyun turmoil, Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng fell to Shu. Meng Chang made Huan commissioner of Feng.

manualTranslations.zh: 周世宗即位，明年，遣王景、向訓攻秦、鳳州，數為環所敗，大臣皆請罷兵。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhou Shizong took the throne, the next year he sent Wang Jing and Xiang Xun to attack Qin and Feng prefectures; they were repeatedly defeated by Huan, and the great ministers all asked to withdraw the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizong took the throne and the next year sent Wang Jing and Xiang Xun against Qin and Feng. Huan beat them again and again, and the ministers all urged withdrawal.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗曰：「吾欲一天下以為家，而聲教不及秦、鳳，今兵已出，無功而返，吾有慚焉。」
manualTranslations.literal: Shizong said: "I wish to make the realm one household, yet my civilizing influence does not reach Qin and Feng. The army is already out—if we return without merit, I shall be ashamed."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizong said: "I mean to make the realm one household, yet my rule has not reached Qin and Feng. The army is already out—return without victory and I am ashamed."

manualTranslations.zh: 乃決意攻之。
manualTranslations.literal: He therefore resolved to press the attack.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He resolved to press the attack.

manualTranslations.zh: 周兵糧道頗艱，昶遣兵五千出堂倉抵黃花谷以爭糧道。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou troops found the grain route quite difficult; Chang sent five thousand men out from Tangcang toward Huanghuagu to contest the supply line.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou supply lines were hard. Chang sent five thousand men from Tangcang toward Huanghuagu to seize the grain route.

manualTranslations.zh: 景、訓先知其來，命排陣使張建雄以兵二千當谷口，別遣裨將以勁兵千人出其後，伏堂倉以待其歸。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing and Xun learned of their approach beforehand and ordered formation commissioner Zhang Jianxiong with two thousand troops to block the valley mouth, while separately sending a deputy general with a thousand crack troops around behind them, lying in ambush at Tangcang to await their return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing and Xun learned of the move and sent formation commissioner Zhang Jianxiong with two thousand men to hold the valley mouth, while a deputy with a thousand crack troops circled behind and lay in wait at Tangcang.

manualTranslations.zh: 蜀兵前遇建雄，戰不勝，退走堂倉，伏發，盡殪之，由是蜀兵守諸城堡者皆潰。
manualTranslations.literal: The Shu troops ahead met Jianxiong, fought without victory, and retreated toward Tangcang; the ambush sprang and slaughtered them all. Thereupon the Shu soldiers holding the various forts all broke and fled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Shu van met Jianxiong, lost, and fled toward Tangcang. The ambush rose and slaughtered them all, and every Shu garrison broke.

sourceRange.text: __TOC__王峻字秀峯，相州安陽人也。父豐，為樂營將。峻少以善歌事梁節度使張筠。唐莊宗已下魏博，筠棄相州，走歸京師。租庸使趙巖過筠家，筠命峻歌佐酒，巖見而悅之。是時巖方用事，筠因以峻遺巖。梁亡，巖族誅，峻流落民間。久之，事三司使張延朗，延朗不甚愛之。晉高祖滅唐，殺延朗，是時漢高祖從晉起兵，因悉以延朗貲產賜之，峻因得事漢高祖。高祖鎮河東，峻為客將。高祖即位，拜峻客省使。漢遣郭從義討趙思綰，以峻監其軍。累遷宣徽北院使。

manualTranslations.literal: In youth Jun, skilled in song, served Liang military commissioner Zhang Jun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a youth Jun, famed for song, served Liang commissioner Zhang Jun.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐莊宗已下魏博，筠棄相州，走歸京師。
manualTranslations.literal: When Tang’s Zhuangzong descended on Wei-Bo, Zhang Jun abandoned Xiang prefecture and fled to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took Wei-Bo, Zhang Jun abandoned Xiang and fled to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 租庸使趙巖過筠家，筠命峻歌佐酒，巖見而悅之。
manualTranslations.literal: Grain-and-labor commissioner Zhao Yan passed Zhang Jun’s house; Zhang Jun ordered Jun to sing to accompany the wine, and Yan saw him and was pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grain commissioner Zhao Yan visited Zhang Jun’s house. Zhang Jun had Wang Jun sing for the wine, and Yan was pleased.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時巖方用事，筠因以峻遺巖。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Yan was in power, and Zhang Jun therefore presented Jun to Yan as a gift.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan was then in power, and Zhang Jun gave Jun to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁亡，巖族誅，峻流落民間。
manualTranslations.literal: When Liang fell, Yan’s clan was executed, and Jun drifted among the common people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liang fell, Yan’s clan was executed and Jun was cast adrift among the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，事三司使張延朗，延朗不甚愛之。
manualTranslations.literal: After long time he served Three Departments commissioner Zhang Yanlang, but Yanlang did not much favor him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After long wandering he served Three Departments commissioner Zhang Yanlang, who did not much favor him.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖滅唐，殺延朗，是時漢高祖從晉起兵，因悉以延朗貲產賜之，峻因得事漢高祖。
manualTranslations.literal: Jin Gaozu destroyed Tang and killed Yanlang. At that time Han Gaozu rose with Jin in arms and therefore bestowed all of Yanlang’s property on him; Jun thereby came to serve Han Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jin Gaozu destroyed Tang and killed Yanlang. Han Gaozu rose with Jin and received all Yanlang’s property; Jun thereby entered Han Gaozu’s service.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖鎮河東，峻為客將。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu governed Hedong, Jun was a guest general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu governed Hedong, Jun was a guest general.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，拜峻客省使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, he appointed Jun Guest Reception Commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, he made Jun Guest Reception Commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢遣郭從義討趙思綰，以峻監其軍。

sourceRange.text: 明宗即位，拜守殷同中書門下平章事、河南尹、判六軍諸衞事。明年，遷宣武軍節度使。九月，明宗詔幸汴州，議者喧然，或以為征吳，或以為東諸侯有屈彊者，將制置之。守殷尤不自安，乃殺指揮使馬彥超，閉城反。明宗行至京水，聞守殷反，遣范延光馳兵傅其城，汴人開門納延光，守殷自殺其族，乃引頸命左右斬之。明宗至汴州，命鞭其尸，梟首于市七日，傳徇洛陽。

sourceRange.text: 安重榮，小字鐵胡，朔州人也。祖從義，利州刺史。父全，勝州刺史、振武馬步軍都指揮使。重榮有力，善騎射，為振武巡邊指揮使。晉高祖起太原，使張潁陰招重榮，其母與兄皆以為不可，重榮業已許潁，母、兄謀共殺潁以止之，重榮曰：「未可，吾當為母卜之。」乃立一箭，百步而射之，曰：「石公為天子則中。」一發輒中；又立一箭而射之，曰：「吾為節度使則中。」一發又中，其母、兄乃許，重榮以巡邊千騎叛入太原。高祖即位，拜重榮成德軍節度使。

sourceRange.text: 天成四年，明宗祀天南郊，詔兩川貢助南郊物五十萬，使李仁矩賫安重誨書往諭璋，璋訴不肯出，秖出十萬而已。又因事欲殺仁矩，仁矩涕泣而免，歸言璋必反。其後使者至東川，璋益倨慢，使者還，多言璋欲反狀。重誨患之，乃稍擇將吏為兩川刺史，以精兵為其牙衞，分布其諸州。又分閬州置保寧軍，以仁矩為節度使，遣姚洪將兵千人從仁矩戍閬州。璋及知祥覺唐疑己，且削其地，遂連謀以反。璋因為其子娶知祥女以相結。又遣其將李彥釗扼劍門關為七砦，於關北增置關，號永定。凡唐戍兵東歸者，皆遮留之，獲其逃者，覆以鐵籠，火炙之，或刲肉釘面，割心而啖。長興元年九月，知祥攻陷遂州，璋攻陷閬州，執李仁矩、姚洪，皆殺之。

sourceRange.text: 范延光反，以為魏府都招討使，久之不能下，高祖卒用佗計降延光。而光遠自以握重兵在外，謂高祖畏己，始為恣橫。高祖每優容之，為選其子承祚尚長安公主，其次子承信等皆超拜官爵，恩寵無比。樞密使桑維翰惡之，數以為言。光遠自魏來朝，屢指維翰擅權難制。高祖不得已，罷出維翰於相州，亦徙光遠西京留守，兼鎮河陽，奪其兵職。光遠始大怨望，陰以寶貨奉契丹，訴己為晉疏斥。所養部曲千人，撓法犯禁河、洛之間，甚於寇盜。天福五年，徙鎮平盧，封東平王。光遠請其子以行，乃拜承祚單州刺史，承勳萊州防禦使，父子俱東，車騎連屬數十里。出帝即位，拜太師，封壽王。

sourceRange.text: 延光常夢大蛇自臍入其腹，半入而掣去之，以問門下術士張生，張生贊曰：「蛇，龍類也，入腹內，王者之兆也。」張生自延光微時，言其必貴，延光素神之，常置門下，言多輒中，遂以其言為然，由是頗畜異志。當晉高祖起太原，末帝遣延光以兵二萬屯遼州，與趙延壽掎角。既而延壽先降，延光獨不降。高祖即位，延光賀表又頗後諸侯至，又其女為末帝子重美妃，以此遂懷反側。高祖封延光臨清王以慰其心。有平山人祕瓊者，為成德軍節度使董溫其衙內指揮使，後溫其為契丹所虜，瓊乃悉殺溫其家族，瘞之一穴，而取其家貲鉅萬計。晉高祖入立，以瓊為齊州防禦使，橐其貲裝，道出于魏。延光陰遣人以書招之，瓊不納，延光怒，選兵伏境上，伺瓊過，殺之于夏津，悉取其貲，以戍邏者悞殺聞。

localRange.text: 有平山人秘瓊者，為成德軍節度使董溫其衙內指揮使，後溫其為契丹所虜，瓊乃悉殺溫其家族，瘞之一穴，而取其家貲巨萬計，晉高祖入立，以瓊為齊州防禦使，橐其貲裝，道出於魏。延光陰遣人以書招之，瓊不納，延光怒，選兵伏境上，伺瓊過，殺之於夏津，悉取其貲，以戍邏者誤殺聞。

sourceRange.text: 」高祖崩，祕不發喪，大臣乃共誅之，及其子弘璋、弘璨、弘璲尸於市，市人蹴而詬之，吏不能禁，支裂蹈踐，斯須而盡。李守貞，河陽人也。晉高祖鎮河陽，以為客將，其後嘗從高祖，高祖即位，拜客省使。監馬全節軍破李金全於安州，以功拜宣徽使。出帝即位，楊光遠反，召契丹入寇。守貞領義成軍節度使，為侍衞親軍都虞候，從出帝幸澶州。麻荅以奇兵入鄆州，渡馬家口，柵於河東。守貞馳往破之，契丹兵多溺死，獲馬數百匹，裨將七十餘人。徙領泰寧軍節度使，以兵二萬討之。光遠降，其故吏宋顏悉取光遠寶貨、名姬、善馬獻之守貞，守貞德之，陰置顏麾下。是時，凡出師破賊，必有德音赦其餘類。而光遠黨與十餘人皆亡命，捕之甚急，樞密使桑維翰緩其制書，久而不下。言事者告顏匿守貞所，詔取顏殺之，守貞大怒，乃與維翰有隙。

manualTranslations.zh: 李守貞，河陽人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Shouzhen was a man of Heyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was from Heyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖鎮河陽，以為客將，其後嘗從高祖，高祖即位，拜客省使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jin Gaozu governed Heyang, he made Shouzhen a guest general. Later he often followed Gaozu, and when Gaozu took the throne he was appointed commissioner of the guest bureau.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jin Gaozu governed Heyang, he made Shouzhen a guest general. He later often followed Gaozu, and when Gaozu took the throne Shouzhen was appointed commissioner of the guest bureau.

manualTranslations.zh: 監馬全節軍破李金全於安州，以功拜宣徽使。
manualTranslations.literal: Supervising Ma Quanjie's army, he defeated Li Jinquan at Anzhou and, for his merit, was made commissioner of the palace secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Supervising Ma Quanjie's army, he defeated Li Jinquan at Anzhou and was made commissioner of the palace secretariat for his merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 出帝即位，楊光遠反，召契丹入寇。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Chudi took the throne, Yang Guangyuan rebelled and summoned the Khitan to invade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Chudi took the throne, Yang Guangyuan rebelled and called in the Khitan to invade.

manualTranslations.zh: 守貞領義成軍節度使，為侍衞親軍都虞候，從出帝幸澶州。
manualTranslations.literal: Shouzhen held the Yicheng army military governorship and served as chief adjutant of the palace personal guard, following Chudi in person to Chanzou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shouzhen held the Yicheng military governorship and served as chief adjutant of the palace personal guard, accompanying Chudi in person to Chanzou.

manualTranslations.zh: 麻荅以奇兵入鄆州，渡馬家口，柵於河東。
manualTranslations.literal: Ma Da entered Yanzhou with a surprise force, crossed Majiakou, and fortified on the east bank of the river.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ma Da entered Yanzhou with a surprise force, crossed Majiakou, and fortified on the east bank of the river.

manualTranslations.zh: 守貞馳往破之，契丹兵多溺死，獲馬數百匹，裨將七十餘人。
manualTranslations.literal: Shouzhen rushed to attack and defeated them. Many Khitan soldiers drowned, and he captured several hundred horses and more than seventy lieutenant generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shouzhen rushed to attack and defeated them. Many Khitan soldiers drowned, and he captured several hundred horses and more than seventy lieutenant generals.

manualTranslations.zh: 徙領泰寧軍節度使，以兵二萬討之。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to govern the Taining army and marched against Guangyuan with twenty thousand troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Taining military governorship and marched against Guangyuan with twenty thousand troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 光遠降，其故吏宋顏悉取光遠寶貨、名姬、善馬獻之守貞，守貞德之，陰置顏麾下。
manualTranslations.literal: When Guangyuan surrendered, his former clerk Song Yan took all Guangyuan's treasures, famous concubines, and fine horses and presented them to Shouzhen. Shouzhen was grateful and secretly placed Yan in his command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Guangyuan surrendered, his former clerk Song Yan took all Guangyuan's treasures, famous concubines, and fine horses and presented them to Shouzhen. Shouzhen was grateful and secretly placed Yan in his command.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，凡出師破賊，必有德音赦其餘類。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time, whenever troops went out and defeated bandits, there was always an edict of grace pardoning the remainder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time, whenever troops went out and defeated rebels, an edict of grace always pardoned the remainder.

manualTranslations.zh: 而光遠黨與十餘人皆亡命，捕之甚急，樞密使桑維翰緩其制書，久而不下。
manualTranslations.literal: But more than ten of Guangyuan's associates were all fugitives and were hunted urgently. Chief councilor Sang Weihan delayed the drafting edict, and for a long time it was not issued.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But more than ten of Guangyuan's associates were fugitives and were hunted urgently. Chief councilor Sang Weihan delayed the drafting edict, and for a long time it was not issued.

manualTranslations.zh: 言事者告顏匿守貞所，詔取顏殺之，守貞大怒，乃與維翰有隙。
manualTranslations.literal: Memorialists reported that Yan was hidden at Shouzhen's residence. An edict ordered Yan seized and killed. Shouzhen was furious and thus had a breach with Weihan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Memorialists reported that Yan was hidden at Shouzhen's residence. An edict ordered Yan seized and killed. Shouzhen was furious and thus fell out with Weihan.

sourceRange.text: __TOC__王景崇，邢州人也。為人明敏巧辯，善事人。唐明宗鎮邢州，以為牙將，其後嘗從明宗，隸麾下。明宗即位，拜通事舍人，歷引進閤門使，馳詔方鎮、監軍征伐，必用景崇。後事晉，累拜左金吾衞大將軍，常怏怏人主不能用其材。晉亡，蕭翰據京師，景崇厚賂其將高牟翰以求用。已而翰北歸，許王從益居京師，用景崇為宣徽使、監左藏庫。漢高祖起太原，景崇取庫金奔迎高祖，高祖至京師，拜景崇右衞大將軍，未之奇也。高祖攻鄴，景崇不得從，乃求留守起居表，詣行在一本作宮。見高祖，願留軍中効用，為高祖畫攻戰之策，甚有辯，高祖乃奇其材。

context.afterSource: 是時，漢方新造，鳳翔侯益、永興趙贊皆嘗受命契丹，高祖立，益等內顧自疑，乃陰召蜀人為助，高祖患之。

manualTranslations.zh: 王景崇，邢州人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Jingchong was a man of Xingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Jingchong was from Xingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 為人明敏巧辯，善事人。
manualTranslations.literal: As a man he was bright, quick, and artful in speech, and skilled at winning people over.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was clever, quick-witted, and artful in speech, and skilled at winning people over.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐明宗鎮邢州，以為牙將，其後嘗從明宗，隸麾下。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Mingzong of Tang held Xingzhou, Jingchong was made a personal guard officer; afterward he once followed Mingzong and served under his command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Mingzong of Tang governed Xingzhou, Jingchong was made a personal guard officer; later he followed Mingzong and served in his entourage.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗即位，拜通事舍人，歷引進閤門使，馳詔方鎮、監軍征伐，必用景崇。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, Jingchong was appointed communications attendant, then served as introducer usher; when edicts were rushed to regional commands and supervising armies on campaign, Jingchong was always used.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong came to the throne, Jingchong was made communications attendant and then introducer usher; whenever edicts were rushed to regional commands or supervising armies on campaign, Jingchong was always the man sent.

manualTranslations.zh: 後事晉，累拜左金吾衞大將軍，常怏怏人主不能用其材。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he served Jin and was repeatedly promoted to general of the Left Golden Guard, but was often resentful that the ruler would not employ his talent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later served Jin and rose to general of the Left Golden Guard, but often brooded that his ruler would not use his abilities.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉亡，蕭翰據京師，景崇厚賂其將高牟翰以求用。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jin fell, Xiao Han held the capital. Jingchong lavished bribes on his general Gao Muhann to seek employment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jin fell, Xiao Han seized the capital. Jingchong bribed Han’s general Gao Muhann heavily in hope of winning a post.

manualTranslations.zh: 已而翰北歸，許王從益居京師，用景崇為宣徽使、監左藏庫。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long Han returned north. The Prince of Xu Congyi held the capital and employed Jingchong as palace commissioner and overseer of the Left Treasury.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long Han returned north. The Prince of Xu Congyi held the capital and made Jingchong palace commissioner and overseer of the Left Treasury.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢高祖起太原，景崇取庫金奔迎高祖，高祖至京師，拜景崇右衞大將軍，未之奇也。
manualTranslations.literal: When Han Gaozu rose at Taiyuan, Jingchong took treasury gold and rushed to welcome him. When Gaozu reached the capital he appointed Jingchong general of the Right Guard, but did not yet think him remarkable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Han Gaozu raised his banner at Taiyuan, Jingchong seized treasury gold and raced to meet him. Gaozu reached the capital and made Jingchong general of the Right Guard, but had not yet marked him as extraordinary.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖攻鄴，景崇不得從，乃求留守起居表，詣行在一本作宮。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu attacked Ye, Jingchong could not accompany him. He therefore sought leave to remain behind and present routine memorials, and went to the mobile court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu attacked Ye, Jingchong could not march with him. He asked leave to stay behind and present routine memorials, then went to the mobile court.

manualTranslations.zh: 見高祖，願留軍中効用，為高祖畫攻戰之策，甚有辯，高祖乃奇其材。
manualTranslations.literal: Seeing Gaozu, he wished to remain with the army and serve usefully. He drew up battle plans for Gaozu and argued them with great eloquence, and Gaozu then thought his talent remarkable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He saw Gaozu and asked to remain with the army and prove useful. He laid out battle plans for Gaozu and argued them with great force, and Gaozu then marked him as a man of talent.

sourceRange.text: 趙思綰，魏州人也。為河中節度使趙贊牙將。漢高祖即位，徙贊鎮永興，贊入朝京師，留思綰兵數百人於永興。高祖遣王景崇至永興，與齊藏珍以兵迎回鶻，陰以西事屬之。景崇至永興，贊雖入朝，而其所召蜀兵已據子午谷，景崇用思綰兵擊走之。遂與思綰俱西，然以非己兵，懼思綰等有二心，意欲黥其面以自隨，而難言之，乃稍微風其旨。思綰厲聲請先黥以率眾，齊藏珍惡之，竊勸景崇殺思綰，景崇不聽，與俱西。

sourceRange.text: 唐莊宗自鄆州入汴，末帝聞唐兵且至，惶恐不知所為，與李振、敬翔等相持慟哭，因召珏問計安出，珏曰：「臣有一策，不知陛下能行否？」末帝問其策如何，珏曰：「願得陛下傳國寶馳入唐軍，以緩其行，而待救兵之至。」帝曰：「事急矣，寶固不足惜，顧卿之行，能了事否？」珏俛首徐思曰：「但恐不易了。」於是左右皆大笑。莊宗入汴，珏率百官迎謁道左。貶萊州司戶參軍，量移曹州司馬。張全義為言於郭崇韜，復召為太子賓客。明宗即位，欲用任圜為相，而安重誨以圜新進，不欲獨相之，以問樞密使孔循。循嘗事梁，與珏善，因言珏故梁相，性謹慎而長者，乃拜珏平章事。

sourceRange.text: __TOC__劉昫，涿州歸義人也。昫為人美風儀，與其兄暄、弟暤，皆以好學知名燕、薊之間。後為定州王處直觀察推官。處直為子都所囚，昫兄暄亦為怨家所殺，昫乃避之滄州。唐莊宗即位，拜昫太常博士，以為翰林學士，明宗時，累遷兵部侍郎居職。明宗素重昫而愛其風韻，遷端明殿學士。長興三年，拜中書侍郎兼刑部尚書、同中書門下平章事，昫詣中興殿門謝，是日大祠不坐，昫入謝端明殿。昫自端明殿學士拜相，當時以此為榮。廢帝入立，遷吏部尚書、門下侍郎，監修國史。

sourceRange.text: 高祖將幸鄴，而襄州安從進反迹已見。凝曰：「陛下幸鄴，從進必因此時反，則將奈何？」高祖曰：「卿將何以待之？」凝曰：「先人者，所以奪人也。請為宣敕十餘通，授之鄭王，有急則命將擊之。」高祖以為然。是時，鄭王為開封尹，留不從幸，乃授以宣敕。高祖至鄴，從進果反，鄭王即以宣敕命騎將李建崇、焦繼勳等討之。從進謂高祖方幸鄴，不意晉兵之速也，行至花山，遇建崇等兵，以為神，遂敗走。出帝即位，加右僕射，歲餘，罷平章事，遷左僕射。漢高祖時，拜太子太傅，封魯國公。顯德二年卒，年五十八，贈侍中。

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖將幸鄴，而襄州安從進反迹已見。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu was about to visit Ye when signs of rebellion by An Congjin of Xiang Prefecture had already appeared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu was preparing to visit Ye when signs that An Congjin of Xiang Prefecture would rebel had already appeared.

manualTranslations.zh: 凝曰：「陛下幸鄴，從進必因此時反，則將奈何？」
manualTranslations.literal: Ning said: "If Your Majesty visits Ye, Congjin will surely rebel at this time—what then shall we do?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ning said, "If Your Majesty visits Ye, Congjin will surely rebel at that moment—what then shall we do?"

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖曰：「卿將何以待之？」
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu said: "How will you deal with it?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu asked, "How would you handle it?"

manualTranslations.zh: 凝曰：「先人者，所以奪人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Ning said: "To act first is to seize the initiative from others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ning said, "To strike first is to seize the initiative from others.

manualTranslations.zh: 請為宣敕十餘通，授之鄭王，有急則命將擊之。」
manualTranslations.literal: Please prepare more than ten blank edicts and give them to the Prince of Zheng; in an emergency he can order generals to strike."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prepare more than ten blank edicts and give them to the Prince of Zheng; if there is an emergency, he can order generals to attack."

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖以為然。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu thought this correct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu agreed.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，鄭王為開封尹，留不從幸，乃授以宣敕。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Prince of Zheng was metropolitan prefect of Kaifeng and remained behind rather than accompany the tour; he was given the blank edicts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the Prince of Zheng was metropolitan prefect of Kaifeng and stayed behind rather than accompany the tour; he was given the blank edicts.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖至鄴，從進果反，鄭王即以宣敕命騎將李建崇、焦繼勳等討之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu reached Ye, Congjin did rebel. The Prince of Zheng immediately used the blank edicts to order cavalry generals Li Jianchong, Jiao Jixun, and others to campaign against him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu reached Ye, Congjin rebelled as expected. The Prince of Zheng immediately used the blank edicts to order cavalry generals Li Jianchong, Jiao Jixun, and others to suppress him.

manualTranslations.zh: 從進謂高祖方幸鄴，不意晉兵之速也，行至花山，遇建崇等兵，以為神，遂敗走。
manualTranslations.literal: Congjin thought Gaozu was still visiting Ye and did not expect Jin troops to arrive so swiftly. Marching to Huashan, he met Jianchong and the others, took them for divine intervention, and fled in defeat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Congjin assumed Gaozu was still at Ye and did not expect Jin troops to move so quickly. At Huashan he met Jianchong and the others, took them for a miracle, and fled in defeat.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xiande he died at fifty-eight and was posthumously granted the title of palace attendant.

manualTranslations.literal: After more than a year he retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: More than a year later he retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，年七十八，贈左僕射。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at the age of seventy-eight and was posthumously granted the title of Left Vice Director.

sourceRange.text: 盧質字子徵，河南人也。父望，唐司勳郎中。質幼聰惠，善屬文。事唐為祕書郎，丁母憂，解職。後去遊太原，晉王以為河東節度掌書記。質與張承業等定議立莊宗為嗣。莊宗將即位，以質為大禮使，拜行臺禮部尚書。莊宗即位，欲以質為相。質性疎逸，不欲任責，因固辭不受。拜太原尹、北京留守，遷戶部尚書、翰林學士。從平梁，權判租庸，遷兵部尚書，後為學士承旨，仍賜「論思匡佐功臣」。天成元年，拜匡國軍節度使。三年，拜兵部尚書，判太常卿事。歷鎮河陽、橫海。初，梁已篡唐，封哀帝為濟陰王，既而酖殺之，瘞于曹州。

manualTranslations.zh: 盧質字子徵，河南人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Lu Zhi, courtesy name Zizheng, was a native of Henan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi, whose courtesy name was Zizheng, came from Henan.

manualTranslations.zh: 父望，唐司勳郎中。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Wang served as a bureau director in the Tang Ministry of Personnel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Wang had been a bureau director in the Tang Ministry of Personnel.

manualTranslations.zh: 質幼聰惠，善屬文。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth Zhi was clever and skilled at literary composition.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a boy, Zhi was clever and skilled at writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 事唐為祕書郎，丁母憂，解職。
manualTranslations.literal: Serving Tang he was a secretary; when his mother died he left office in mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served Tang as a secretary, then left office to mourn his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 後去遊太原，晉王以為河東節度掌書記。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he traveled to Taiyuan and the Prince of Jin made him secretary of the Hedong military governorship.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he went to Taiyuan, where the Prince of Jin made him secretary of the Hedong military governorship.

manualTranslations.zh: 質與張承業等定議立莊宗為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi, with Zhang Chengye and others, resolved to install Zhuangzong as heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhi joined Zhang Chengye and others in resolving to install Zhuangzong as heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗將即位，以質為大禮使，拜行臺禮部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong was about to take the throne, he made Zhi director of the great rites and appointed him Minister of Rites of the mobile administration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong was about to take the throne, he made Zhi director of the great rites and appointed him minister of rites of the mobile administration.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗即位，欲以質為相。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne he wished to make Zhi chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took the throne he wished to make Zhi chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 質性疎逸，不欲任責，因固辭不受。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi was by nature casual and retiring and did not wish to bear responsibility, so he firmly declined.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhi was by nature casual and easygoing and did not wish to bear heavy responsibility, so he firmly declined.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜太原尹、北京留守，遷戶部尚書、翰林學士。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed metropolitan prefect of Taiyuan and protector of the Northern Capital, then transferred to Minister of Revenue and Hanlin academician.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed metropolitan prefect of Taiyuan and protector of the Northern Capital, then promoted to minister of revenue and Hanlin academician.

manualTranslations.zh: 從平梁，權判租庸，遷兵部尚書，後為學士承旨，仍賜「論思匡佐功臣」。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the campaign to pacify Liang and acted as controller of the tax and corvée system, was transferred to Minister of War, then became chief academician and was granted the title "Meritorious Minister of Counsel and Support."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign to pacify Liang, acted as controller of the tax and corvée system, was promoted to minister of war, then became chief academician and was granted the title "Meritorious Minister of Counsel and Support."

manualTranslations.zh: 天成元年，拜匡國軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tiancheng he was appointed military commissioner of the Kuangguo Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tiancheng he was made military commissioner of the Kuangguo Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，拜兵部尚書，判太常卿事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was appointed Minister of War and overseer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made minister of war and overseer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷鎮河陽、橫海。
manualTranslations.literal: He served in succession as commissioner of Heyang and the Trans-Maritime circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served in succession as commissioner of Heyang and the Trans-Maritime circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，梁已篡唐，封哀帝為濟陰王，既而酖殺之，瘞于曹州。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning, after Liang had usurped Tang, it enfeoffed Emperor Ai as Prince of Jiyin; afterward it poisoned him and buried him at Cao Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Later Liang usurped Tang, it enfeoffed Emperor Ai as Prince of Jiyin, then poisoned him and buried him at Cao Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 鏻事晉累遷太子太保。
manualTranslations.literal: Lin served Jin and was repeatedly promoted until he became Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lin served the Later Jin and rose through repeated promotions to grand preceptor of the heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢高祖即位，拜鏻司徒，居數月卒，年八十八，贈太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: When Han Gaozu took the throne he appointed Lin Minister of Education; after several months he died at eighty-eight and was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Later Han Gaozu took the throne he appointed Lin minister of education; he died several months later at eighty-eight and was posthumously honored as grand tutor.

sourceRange.text: 王松，父徽，為唐僖宗宰相。松舉進士，後唐時，歷刑部郎中，唐末，從事方鎮。晉高祖鎮太原，辟松節度判官。晉高祖即位，拜右諫議大夫，累拜工部尚書。出帝北遷，蕭翰立許王從益於京師，以松為左丞相。漢高祖入洛，先遣人馳詔東京百官嘗授偽命者皆焚之，使勿自疑，由是御史臺悉斂百官偽敕焚之。松以手指其胸，引郭子儀自誚，以語人曰：「此乃二十四考中書令也。」聞者笑之。後松子仁寶為李守貞河中支使，守貞反，松以子故上書自陳，高祖憐之，但使解職而已。松有田城東，歲時往來京師，以疾卒。

context.beforeSource: 周太祖以兵入京師，允匿于佛殿承塵，墜而卒，年六十五。
context.afterSource: 裴皞字司東，河東人也。
context.beforeLocal: 周太祖以兵入京師，允匿於佛殿承塵，墜而卒，年六十五。
context.afterLocal: 裴皞，字司東，河東人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 王松，父徽，為唐僖宗宰相。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Song's father Hui was a chief minister under Tang Emperor Xizong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Song's father Hui had been a chief minister under Emperor Xizong of Tang.

manualTranslations.zh: 松舉進士，後唐時，歷刑部郎中，唐末，從事方鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: Song passed the jinshi examination; in Later Tang he served as Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice; at the end of Tang he served a regional command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song passed the jinshi examination; under Later Tang he served as bureau director in the Ministry of Justice, and at the end of Tang worked for a regional command.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖鎮太原，辟松節度判官。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jin Gaozu governed Taiyuan he recruited Song as military administrator of the command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shi Jingtang governed Taiyuan he recruited Song as military administrator of the command.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖即位，拜右諫議大夫，累拜工部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jin Gaozu took the throne he appointed Song Right Remonstrance Grand Master and repeatedly promoted him to Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shi Jingtang took the throne he appointed Song right remonstrance grand master and eventually minister of works.

manualTranslations.zh: 出帝北遷，蕭翰立許王從益於京師，以松為左丞相。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Chu was moved north, Xiao Han installed Prince Xu Congyi in the capital and made Song left chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Chu was taken north, Xiao Han installed Prince Xu Congyi at the capital and appointed Song left chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢高祖入洛，先遣人馳詔東京百官嘗授偽命者皆焚之，使勿自疑，由是御史臺悉斂百官偽敕焚之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Han Gaozu entered Luoyang he first sent men with urgent edicts ordering that the eastern capital officials who had once accepted false appointments all burn them so they should not doubt themselves; on this account the Censorate collected and burned all the officials' false commissions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Later Han Gaozu entered Luoyang he first sent urgent edicts to the eastern capital ordering officials who had accepted Khitan appointments to burn those documents and put their minds at ease; the Censorate accordingly collected and burned the officials' false commissions.

manualTranslations.zh: 松以手指其胸，引郭子儀自誚，以語人曰：「此乃二十四考中書令也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Song pointed at his chest, citing Guo Ziyi in self-mockery, and said to people: "This is a chief minister who held office through twenty-four annual reviews."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song pointed at his chest, alluding to Guo Ziyi in self-mockery, and told others, "Here is a chief minister with twenty-four annual reviews to his credit."

manualTranslations.zh: 聞者笑之。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who heard laughed at him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who heard laughed.

manualTranslations.zh: 後松子仁寶為李守貞河中支使，守貞反，松以子故上書自陳，高祖憐之，但使解職而已。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Song's son Renbao served as branch commissioner for Li Shouzhen in Hezhong; when Shouzhen rebelled, Song because of his son submitted a memorial explaining himself; Gaozu pitied him and only had him relieved of office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Song's son Renbao served as branch commissioner under Li Shouzhen at Hezhong; when Shouzhen rebelled, Song memorialized in his own defense because of his son; Gaozu took pity on him and merely had him relieved of office.

manualTranslations.zh: 松有田城東，歲時往來京師，以疾卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Song had farmland east of the city and each year traveled back and forth to the capital; he died of illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song owned farmland east of the city and traveled to and from the capital each year; he died of illness.

sourceRange.text: 高祖崩，出帝即位，以崧兼判三司，與馮玉對掌樞密。是時，晉兵敗契丹於陽城，趙延壽在幽州，詐言思歸以誘晉兵，崧等信之。初，漢高祖在晉，掌親軍，為侍衞都指揮使，與杜重威同制加平章事，漢高祖恥之。怒不肯謝，晉高祖遣和凝諭之，乃謝。其後漢高祖出居太原，重威代為侍衞使，崧亦數稱重威之材，於是漢高祖以崧為排己，深恨之。崧又信延壽之詐以為然，卒以重威將大兵，其後敗于中渡，晉遂以亡。

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖崩，出帝即位，以崧兼判三司，與馮玉對掌樞密。
manualTranslations.literal: When the high ancestor died, Emperor Chu took the throne and made Song concurrently administer the Three Departments, sharing command of the Secretariat with Feng Yu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu died, Emperor Chu ascended the throne and made Song concurrently head the Three Departments, sharing Secretariat affairs with Feng Yu.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，晉兵敗契丹於陽城，趙延壽在幽州，詐言思歸以誘晉兵，崧等信之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Jin forces defeated the Khitan at Yangcheng; Zhao Yanshou was at Youzhou and falsely claimed he wished to return to lure Jin troops; Song and the others believed it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Jin forces defeated the Khitan at Yangcheng; Zhao Yanshou at Youzhou falsely claimed he wished to return home to lure Jin troops, and Song and the others believed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，漢高祖在晉，掌親軍，為侍衞都指揮使，與杜重威同制加平章事，漢高祖恥之。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when Later Han Gaozu was in Jin territory, he commanded the imperial guard as commander of the Palace Guard; Du Chongwei received the same appointment as councilor, and Gaozu was humiliated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Later Han Gaozu was serving Jin, he commanded the imperial guard as commander of the Palace Guard; Du Chongwei received the same concurrent appointment as councilor, and Gaozu was humiliated.

manualTranslations.zh: 怒不肯謝，晉高祖遣和凝諭之，乃謝。
manualTranslations.literal: Angry, he refused to offer thanks; Jin Gaozu sent He Ning to instruct him, and only then did he thank them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In anger he refused to offer thanks; Jin Gaozu sent He Ning to remonstrate with him, and only then did he thank the court.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後漢高祖出居太原，重威代為侍衞使，崧亦數稱重威之材，於是漢高祖以崧為排己，深恨之。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Gaozu went to live at Taiyuan and Chongwei replaced him as commander of the guard; Song also repeatedly praised Chongwei's talent; Gaozu therefore took Song as working against him and deeply resented him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Gaozu took up residence at Taiyuan and Chongwei replaced him as commander of the guard; Song also repeatedly praised Chongwei's abilities, so Gaozu took Song as working against him and deeply resented him.

manualTranslations.zh: 崧又信延壽之詐以為然，卒以重威將大兵，其後敗于中渡，晉遂以亡。
manualTranslations.literal: Song also believed Yanshou's deception to be true; in the end Chongwei was put in command of the great army, and afterward was defeated at Zhongdu, whereupon Jin perished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song also believed Yanshou's deception; in the end Chongwei was put in command of the main army, was afterwards defeated at Zhongdu, and Jin perished.

sourceRange.text: 應州，故屬大同軍節度。唐明宗即位，以其應州人也，乃置彰國軍。新州，唐同光元年置威塞軍。府州，晉置永安軍，漢罷之，周復。并州，後唐建北都，其軍仍曰河東。

manualTranslations.zh: 應州，故屬大同軍節度。
manualTranslations.literal: Ying Prefecture: formerly under the Datong Army command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ying Prefecture: formerly under the Datong Army command.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐明宗即位，以其應州人也，乃置彰國軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Later Tang Mingzong took the throne, because he was a native of Ying Prefecture, the Zhangguo Army was established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong of Later Tang took the throne, because he came from Ying Prefecture, the Zhangguo Army command was established.

manualTranslations.zh: 新州，唐同光元年置威塞軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Xin Prefecture: in Tang's first year of Tongguang the Weisai Army was established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xin Prefecture: in the first year of Tongguang under Later Tang the Weisai Army command was established.

manualTranslations.zh: 府州，晉置永安軍，漢罷之，周復。
manualTranslations.literal: Fuzhou: Jin established the Yong'an Army; Han abolished it; Zhou restored it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fuzhou: Later Jin established the Yong'an Army command; Later Han abolished it; Later Zhou restored it.

manualTranslations.zh: 并州，後唐建北都，其軍仍曰河東。
manualTranslations.literal: Bing Prefecture: Later Tang established the Northern Capital; its army was still called Hedong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bing Prefecture: Later Tang established the Northern Capital there; its army command remained Hedong.

sourceRange.text: 開封府故統六縣。梁開平元年，割滑州之酸棗、長垣，鄭州之中牟、陽武，宋州之襄邑，曹州之考城更曰戴邑，許州之扶溝、𨻳陵，陳州之太康隸焉。唐分酸棗、中牟、襄邑、𨻳陵、太康五縣還其故，晉升汴州為東京，復割五縣隸焉。雍丘，晉改曰𣏌，漢復其故。

manualTranslations.literal: In Liang's first year of Kaiping, Suanzao and Changyuan from Hua Prefecture, Zhongmou and Yangwu from Zheng Prefecture, Xiangyi from Song Prefecture, Kaocheng from Cao Prefecture (renamed Daiyi), Fugou and Yanling from Xu Prefecture, and Taikang from Chen Prefecture were cut off and assigned to it.

manualTranslations.zh: 據吳錄、運歷圖、九國志皆云行密以唐景福元年，再入揚州，至晉天福二年，為李昪所篡，實四十六年。
manualTranslations.literal: According to the Wu Record, the Calendar of Dynastic Fortune, and the Record of the Nine Kingdoms, all say that Xingmi re-entered Yangzhou in the first year of Jingfu of Tang and was usurped by Li Bian in the second year of Tianfu of Jin—a span of forty-six years in fact.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wu Record, Calendar of Dynastic Fortune, and Record of the Nine Kingdoms all agree that Yang Xingmi re-entered Yangzhou in Jingfu 1 of Tang and was overthrown by Li Bian in Tianfu 2 of Jin, a reign of forty-six years.

manualTranslations.zh: 而舊唐書、舊五代史皆云：大順二年入揚州，至被篡，四十七年。
manualTranslations.literal: But the Old Book of Tang and Old History of the Five Dynasties both say he entered Yangzhou in the second year of Dashun and was usurped forty-seven years later.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Old Book of Tang and Old History of the Five Dynasties, however, say he entered Yangzhou in Dashun 2 and was overthrown forty-seven years later.

manualTranslations.zh: 吳錄徐鉉等撰，運歷圖龔穎撰，二人皆江南故臣，所記宜得實。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wu Record was compiled by Xu Xuan and others, the Calendar of Dynastic Fortune by Gong Ying; both were former subjects of Jiangnan, and their accounts should be accurate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wu Record was written by Xu Xuan and others, the Calendar of Dynastic Fortune by Gong Ying—both former servants of Jiangnan whose records should be trustworthy.

manualTranslations.zh: 而唐末喪亂，中朝文字多差失，故今以鉉、穎所記為定。
manualTranslations.literal: But amid the chaos at the end of Tang, court records from the central dynasty were often erroneous; therefore the accounts of Xuan and Ying are adopted here as definitive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Amid the chaos of late Tang, central-court records were often unreliable, so the accounts of Xuan and Ying are taken as authoritative here.

sourceRange.text: 十六年，春二月，溫率將吏請隆演即天子位，不許。夏四月，溫奉玉冊、寶綬尊隆演即吳王位。建宗廟、社稷，設百官如天子之制，改天祐十六年為武義元年，大赦境內，追尊行密孝武王，廟號太祖，渥景王，廟號烈祖。拜溫大丞相、都督中外諸軍事，封東海郡王，以徐知誥為左僕射、參知政事，嚴可求為門下侍郎，駱知祥為中書侍郎，殷文圭、沈顏為翰林學士，盧擇為吏部尚書，李宗、陳章為左、右雄武統軍，柴再用、錢鏢為左、右龍武統軍，王令謀為內樞密使，江西劉信征南大將軍，鄂州李簡鎮西大將軍，撫州李德誠平南大將軍，廬州張崇安西大將軍，海州王綰鎮東大將軍，文武以次進位。封宗室皆郡公。

context.afterSource: 溫之徙鎮金陵也，以其養子知誥守潤州。

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年，春二月，溫率將吏請隆演即天子位，不許。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year, second month of spring, Wen led officers and clerks to ask Longyan to take the Son of Heaven's throne; it was not granted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, second month of spring, Wen led the court in asking Longyan to take the imperial throne; the request was refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，溫奉玉冊、寶綬尊隆演即吳王位。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Wen presented jade tablets and a precious seal to honor Longyan as King of Wu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Wen presented jade tablets and an imperial seal to install Longyan as King of Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 建宗廟、社稷，設百官如天子之制，改天祐十六年為武義元年，大赦境內，追尊行密孝武王，廟號太祖，渥景王，廟號烈祖。
manualTranslations.literal: He established ancestral temples and altars to land and grain, appointed officials like the Son of Heaven's, changed the sixteenth year of Tianyou to the first year of Wuyi, declared a great amnesty within the borders, and posthumously honored Xingmi as King Xiao Wu with temple title Taizu and Wo as King Jing with temple title Liezu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ancestral temples and state altars were founded, officials were appointed as for an emperor, the sixteenth year of Tianyou was changed to Wuyi 1, a great amnesty was declared, and Xingmi was posthumously honored as King Xiao Wu with temple name Taizu and Wo as King Jing with temple name Liezu.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜溫大丞相、都督中外諸軍事，封東海郡王，以徐知誥為左僕射、參知政事，嚴可求為門下侍郎，駱知祥為中書侍郎，殷文圭、沈顏為翰林學士，盧擇為吏部尚書，李宗、陳章為左、右雄武統軍，柴再用、錢鏢為左、右龍武統軍，王令謀為內樞密使，江西劉信征南大將軍，鄂州李簡鎮西大將軍，撫州李德誠平南大將軍，廬州張崇安西大將軍，海州王綰鎮東大將軍，文武以次進位。
manualTranslations.literal: Wen was appointed Grand Chancellor and Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad and enfeoffed as King of Donghai commandery; Xu Zhigao was made Left Vice Director and Commissioner for Joint Administration of Government Affairs; Yan Keqiu Vice Director of the Chancellery; Luo Zhixiang Vice Director of the Secretariat; Yin Wengui and Shen Yan academicians of the Hanlin; Lu Ze Minister of Personnel; Li Zong and Chen Zhang Left and Right Commanders of Xiongwu; Chai Zaiyong and Qian Biao Left and Right Commanders of Longwu; Wang Lingmou Inner Bureau Director of Military Affairs; Jiangxi Liu Xin Campaign Commander of the South; Ezhou Li Jian Pacification Commander of the West; Fuzhou Li Decheng Pacification Commander of the South; Luzhou Zhang Chong Pacification Commander of the West; Haizhou Wang Guan Pacification Commander of the East; civil and military officials were promoted in turn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen was made Grand Chancellor and commander of all armies at home and abroad and enfeoffed King of the Eastern Sea; Xu Zhigao became Left Vice Director and commissioner for joint administration; Yan Keqiu Vice Director of the Chancellery; Luo Zhixiang Vice Director of the Secretariat; Yin Wengui and Shen Yan Hanlin academicians; Lu Ze Minister of Personnel; Li Zong and Chen Zhang commanders of Xiongwu left and right; Chai Zaiyong and Qian Biao commanders of Longwu left and right; Wang Lingmou Inner Bureau Director of Military Affairs; Liu Xin of Jiangxi Campaign Commander of the South; Li Jian of Ezhou Pacification Commander of the West; Li Decheng of Fuzhou Pacification Commander of the South; Zhang Chong of Luzhou Pacification Commander of the West; Wang Guan of Haizhou Pacification Commander of the East; and civil and military officers were advanced in turn.

manualTranslations.zh: 封宗室皆郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: All members of the royal clan were enfeoffed as dukes of commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Every member of the royal house was enfeoffed as a commandery duke.

sourceRange.text: 久之，未知所嚮，問襲曰：「吾欲卷甲倍道，西取洪州可乎？」襲曰：「鍾傳新得江西，勢未可圖，而秦彥之入廣陵也，召池州刺史趙鍠委以宣州。今彥且死，鍠失所恃，而守宣州非其本志，且其為人非公敵，此可取也。」行密乃引兵攻鍠，戰于曷山，大敗之。進圍宣州，鍠棄城走，追及殺之，行密遂入宣州。龍紀元年，唐拜行密宣州觀察使。行密遣田頵、安仁義、李神福等攻浙西，取蘇、常、潤州。二年，取滁、和州。景福元年，取楚州。孫儒自逐行密，入廣陵，久之，亦不能守，乃焚其城。殺民老疾以餉軍，驅其眾渡江，號五十萬，以攻行密。諸將田頵、劉威等遇之輒敗，行密欲走銅官。其客戴友規曰：「儒來氣銳而兵多，蓋其鋒不可當而可以挫，其眾不可敵而可久以敝之。若避而走，是就擒也。」劉威亦曰：「背城堅柵，可以不戰疲之。」行密以為然。久之，儒兵飢，又大疫，行密悉兵擊之，儒敗，被擒，將死，仰顧見威曰：「聞公為此策以敗我，使我有將如公者，其可敗邪？」行密收儒餘兵數千，以皂衣蒙甲，號「黑雲都」，常以為親軍。

localRange.text: 久之，未知所向，問襲曰：「吾欲卷甲倍道，西取洪州可乎？襲曰：「鐘傳新得江西，勢未可圖，而秦彥之入廣陵也，召池州刺史趙锽委以宣州。今彥且死，锽失所恃，而守宣州非其本誌，且其為人非公敵，此可取也。行密乃引兵攻锽，戰於曷山，大敗之。進圍宣州，锽棄城走，追及殺之，行密遂入宣州。

context.beforeSource: 」行密乃走廬州。
context.afterSource: 是歲，復入揚州，唐拜行密淮南節度使。
context.beforeLocal: 行密乃走廬州。
context.afterLocal: 是歲，復入揚州，唐拜行密淮南節度使。

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，未知所嚮，問襲曰：「吾欲卷甲倍道，西取洪州可乎？」
manualTranslations.literal: After a long while, not knowing which way to turn, he asked Xi: "If I fold my armor and march at double speed to seize Hongzhou in the west, would that do?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After some time, still uncertain where to turn, he asked Xi, "Suppose I strike camp and march at forced pace to seize Hongzhou in the west—would that serve?"

manualTranslations.zh: 襲曰：「鍾傳新得江西，勢未可圖，而秦彥之入廣陵也，召池州刺史趙鍠委以宣州。
manualTranslations.literal: Xi said: "Zhong Chuan has newly taken Jiangxi and his power is not yet to be assailed. When Qin Yan entered Guangling he summoned Zhao Yin, Prefect of Chizhou, and entrusted Xuanzhou to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xi replied, "Zhong Chuan has only lately taken Jiangxi and is not to be challenged yet. When Qin Yan entered Guangling he summoned Zhao Yin, prefect of Chizhou, and gave him Xuanzhou to hold.

manualTranslations.zh: 今彥且死，鍠失所恃，而守宣州非其本志，且其為人非公敵，此可取也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Now Yan is about to die; Yin has lost his support. Holding Xuanzhou was never his original intent, and as a man he is no worthy public foe—this is a place we can take."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan is as good as dead, Yin has lost his patron, holding Xuanzhou was never his true aim, and he is no formidable enemy in his own right—there is our prize."

manualTranslations.zh: 行密乃引兵攻鍠，戰于曷山，大敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xingmi then led troops to attack Yin, fought at Mount He, and routed him utterly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xingmi marched against Yin, met him at Mount He, and routed his army.

manualTranslations.zh: 進圍宣州，鍠棄城走，追及殺之，行密遂入宣州。
manualTranslations.literal: Advancing to besiege Xuanzhou, Yin abandoned the city and fled; pursued and killed, Xingmi then entered Xuanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He pressed on to besiege Xuanzhou; Yin abandoned the city and fled, was overtaken and killed, and Xingmi entered Xuanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 龍紀元年，唐拜行密宣州觀察使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Longji, Tang appointed Xingmi Military Commissioner of Xuanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Longji 1 the Tang court appointed Yang Xingmi military commissioner of Xuanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 行密遣田頵、安仁義、李神福等攻浙西，取蘇、常、潤州。
manualTranslations.literal: Xingmi sent Tian Run, An Renyi, Li Shenfu, and others to attack western Zhe, taking Suzhou, Changzhou, and Runzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xingmi sent Tian Run, An Renyi, Li Shenfu, and others against western Zhe and captured Suzhou, Changzhou, and Runzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，取滁、和州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he took Chuzhou and Hezhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he took Chuzhou and Hezhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 景福元年，取楚州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jingfu he took Chuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jingfu 1 he took Chuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫儒自逐行密，入廣陵，久之，亦不能守，乃焚其城。
manualTranslations.literal: Sun Ru, having driven out Xingmi, entered Guangling; after a long while he too could not hold it and burned the city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Ru expelled Xingmi and entered Guangling; after a time he too could not hold the city and burned it.

manualTranslations.zh: 殺民老疾以餉軍，驅其眾渡江，號五十萬，以攻行密。
manualTranslations.literal: He killed the aged and infirm among the people to feed his army, drove his host across the river claiming five hundred thousand men, and attacked Xingmi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He slaughtered the old and sick to provision his troops, drove his forces across the Yangzi claiming half a million men, and marched against Xingmi.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸將田頵、劉威等遇之輒敗，行密欲走銅官。
manualTranslations.literal: Generals Tian Run, Liu Wei, and others were defeated whenever they met him; Xingmi wished to flee to Tongguan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever Tian Run, Liu Wei, and the other generals met him they were beaten; Xingmi considered fleeing to Tongguan.

manualTranslations.zh: 劉威亦曰：「背城堅柵，可以不戰疲之。」
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Wei also said: "With our backs to the city and stout palisades, we can wear them down without giving battle."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Wei added, "Stand with the city at our backs behind strong palisades, and we can exhaust them without fighting."

manualTranslations.zh: 行密以為然。
manualTranslations.literal: Xingmi thought this right.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xingmi agreed.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，儒兵飢，又大疫，行密悉兵擊之，儒敗，被擒，將死，仰顧見威曰：「聞公為此策以敗我，使我有將如公者，其可敗邪？」
manualTranslations.literal: After a long while Ru's army grew hungry and a great pestilence broke out; Xingmi led out all his troops and attacked. Ru was defeated, captured, and about to die; lifting his head he saw Wei and said: "I hear you used this stratagem to defeat me—had I a general like you, how could I have been beaten?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a time Sun Ru's army starved and plague swept through the camp; Xingmi threw in his whole force and broke him. Ru was taken prisoner, and facing death looked up at Liu Wei and said, "I hear this was your plan that undid me—had I a general like you, how could I have lost?"

manualTranslations.zh: 行密收儒餘兵數千，以皂衣蒙甲，號「黑雲都」，常以為親軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Xingmi took several thousand of Ru's remaining troops, clad them in black garments over armor, called them the "Black Cloud Corps," and regularly used them as his personal guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xingmi enrolled several thousand of Sun Ru's survivors, dressed them in black over their armor, named them the Black Cloud Corps, and kept them as his personal guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 其客戴友規曰：「儒來氣銳而兵多，蓋其鋒不可當而可以挫，其眾不可敵而可久以敝之。
manualTranslations.literal: His guest Dai Yougui said: "Ru comes with sharp spirit and many troops; his edge cannot be met head-on but can be blunted, his host cannot be fought to the finish but can be worn down over time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His adviser Dai Yougui said, "Sun Ru arrives bold and numerous; his spearhead cannot be met squarely but can be blunted, his masses cannot be overpowered but can be worn down.

manualTranslations.zh: 若避而走，是就擒也。」
manualTranslations.literal: If you flee, you will be captured."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If you run, you walk into capture."

manualTranslations.zh: 以故溫雖遙秉大政，而吳人頗已歸昪。
manualTranslations.literal: For this reason, although Wen still held great government from afar, the people of Wu had already largely submitted to Bian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of such conduct, the people of Wu were already turning to Bian even though Xu Wen still held supreme authority from a distance.

manualTranslations.zh: 武義元年，拜左僕射，參知政事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wuyi he was appointed Left Vice Director and Participant in Governance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wuyi he was appointed Left Vice Director and participant in governance.

manualTranslations.zh: 溫行軍司馬徐玠數勸溫以己子代昪，溫遣子知詢入廣陵，謀代昪秉政。
manualTranslations.literal: Xu Wen's campaign marshal Xu Jie repeatedly urged Wen to replace Bian with his own son. Wen sent his son Zhixun into Guangling to plot replacing Bian in holding government.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xu Wen's campaign marshal Xu Jie repeatedly urged Wen to put his own son in Bian's place. Wen sent his son Zhixun to Guangling to plot seizing control from Bian.

manualTranslations.zh: 會溫病卒，知詢奔還金陵，玠反為昪謀，誣知詢以罪，斬其客將周廷望，以知詢為右統軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wen fell ill and died, Zhixun fled back to Jinling. Jie then plotted for Bian instead, falsely accused Zhixun of crimes, beheaded his guest general Zhou Tingwang, and made Zhixun Right Overall Commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xu Wen fell ill and died, Zhixun rushed back to Jinling. Jie then switched sides to Bian, framed Zhixun on criminal charges, executed his guest general Zhou Tingwang, and installed Zhixun as Right Overall Commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 楊溥僭號，拜昪太尉、中書令。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yang Pu usurped the imperial title, Bian was appointed Grand Mentor and Director of the Chancellery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yang Pu took the imperial title, Bian was appointed Grand Mentor and director of the Chancellery.

manualTranslations.zh: 大和三年，出鎮金陵，如溫之制，留其子景通為司徒同平章事，以王令謀宋齊丘為左、右僕射同平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Dahe he went out to station himself at Jinling, following Wen's precedent, left his son Jingtong as Grand Mentor and Co-Director, and made Wang Lingmou and Song Qiqiu Left and Right Vice Directors with concurrent chief minister status.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dahe he took up post at Jinling as Xu Wen had done, left his son Jingtong in Guangling as Grand Mentor and co-director, and appointed Wang Lingmou and Song Qiqiu Left and Right Vice Directors with the rank of chief minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，封昪東海郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year Bian was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Bian was created Prince of Donghai.

manualTranslations.zh: 昪照鑒見白鬚，顧其吏周宗嘆曰：「功業已就，而吾老矣，奈何？」
manualTranslations.literal: Bian looked in a mirror and saw white whiskers. Turning to his officer Zhou Zong he sighed: "The achievement is already done, yet I am old—what is to be done?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bian looked in a mirror, saw white in his beard, and sighed to his officer Zhou Zong, "My work is done, but I am old—what can I do?"

manualTranslations.zh: 徐氏諸子請昪復姓，昪謙抑不敢忘徐氏恩，下其議百官，百官皆請，然後復姓李氏，改名曰昪。
manualTranslations.literal: The sons of the Xu clan requested that Bian restore his surname. With modest restraint Bian dared not forget Xu's kindness, submitted the matter for discussion to the hundred officials, and when all the officials requested it he then restored the surname Li and changed his personal name to Bian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Xu sons asked Bian to resume the Li surname. He demurred, unwilling to seem ungrateful to the Xu house, and put the question to the court. When every official urged it, he took back the name Li and changed his personal name to Bian.

manualTranslations.zh: 自言唐憲宗子建王恪生超，超生志，為徐州判司；
manualTranslations.literal: He declared of himself that Prince Jian, son of Tang Xianzong, named Ke, begot Chao; Chao begot Zhi, who was an aide in the Xuzhou prefectural office;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He claimed descent from Prince Jian, son of Emperor Xianzong of Tang: Ke begot Chao, and Chao begot Zhi, who served as a judicial aide in Xuzhou;

sourceRange.text: 景以馮延巳、常夢錫為翰林學士，馮延魯為中書舍人，陳覺為樞密使，魏岑、查文徽為副使。夢錫直宣政殿，專掌密命，而延巳等皆以邪佞用事，吳人謂之「五鬼」。夢錫屢言五人者不可用，景不納。十二月，景下令中外庶政委齊王景遂參決，惟陳覺、查文徽得奏事，羣臣非召見者，不得入。給事中蕭儼上疏切諫，不報。侍衞軍都虞候賈崇詣閤求見景，曰：「臣事先朝三十年，見先帝所以成功業者，皆用眾賢之謀，故延接疏遠，未嘗壅隔，然下情猶有不達者。今陛下新即位，所信用者何人？奈何頓與臣下隔絕！臣老即死，恐無復一見顏色。」因泣下嗚咽，景為之動容，引與坐，賜食而慰之，遂寢所下令。初，宋齊丘為昪謀篡楊氏最有力，及事成，乃陽入九華山，昪屢招之，乃出。昪僭號，未幾，齊丘以病罷相，出為洪州節度使。

localRange.text: 初，宋齊丘為謀篡楊氏最有力，及事成，乃陽入九華山，屢招之，乃出。僭號，未幾，齊丘以病罷相，出為洪州節度使。

context.afterSource: 景立，復召為相，而陳覺、魏岑等皆為齊丘所引用。

manualTranslations.zh: 景以馮延巳、常夢錫為翰林學士，馮延魯為中書舍人，陳覺為樞密使，魏岑、查文徽為副使。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing made Feng Yansi and Chang Mengxi Hanlin Academicians, Feng Yanlu Secretariat Drafter, Chen Jue Privy Council Director, and Wei Cen and Zha Wen Hui deputy directors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing appointed Feng Yansi and Chang Mengxi Hanlin academicians, Feng Yanlu a secretariat drafter, Chen Jue privy council director, and Wei Cen and Zha Wen Hui his deputies.

manualTranslations.zh: 夢錫直宣政殿，專掌密命，而延巳等皆以邪佞用事，吳人謂之「五鬼」。
manualTranslations.literal: Mengxi served directly in the Xuanzheng Hall and alone handled secret orders, while Yansi and the others all wielded power through wicked flattery. The people of Wu called them the "Five Demons."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mengxi served in the Xuanzheng Hall and alone handled confidential orders, while Yansi and his circle ruled through flattery and deceit. The people of Wu called them the "Five Demons."

manualTranslations.zh: 夢錫屢言五人者不可用，景不納。
manualTranslations.literal: Mengxi repeatedly said the five men were unfit for use; Jing did not accept it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mengxi warned again and again that the five were unfit for office, but Jing would not listen.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，景下令中外庶政委齊王景遂參決，惟陳覺、查文徽得奏事，羣臣非召見者，不得入。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month Jing ordered that all civil and military affairs within and without be referred to Prince of Qi Jing Sui for joint decision; only Chen Jue and Zha Wen Hui might present memorials, and ministers not summoned might not enter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Jing ordered that all government business, civil and military alike, be referred to Prince Jing Sui for joint decision. Only Chen Jue and Zha Wen Hui might present memorials; other ministers could not enter court unless summoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 給事中蕭儼上疏切諫，不報。
manualTranslations.literal: Supervising Secretary Xiao Yan submitted a memorial of stern remonstrance; there was no reply.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Xiao Yan submitted a forceful memorial of protest and received no answer.

manualTranslations.zh: 侍衞軍都虞候賈崇詣閤求見景，曰：「臣事先朝三十年，見先帝所以成功業者，皆用眾賢之謀，故延接疏遠，未嘗壅隔，然下情猶有不達者。
manualTranslations.literal: Palace Guard Army Chief Awaiting Command Jia Chong came to the gate seeking audience with Jing and said: "Your servant served the former court for thirty years and saw how the late emperor achieved his enterprise—all by using the counsel of many worthies. Therefore he received the distant and kept channels open, never blocking them, yet even so lower sentiments sometimes did not get through.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jia Chong, chief awaiting-command of the palace guard, came to the gate and begged to see Jing. He said, "I served the former court for thirty years and watched how the late emperor built his success—always by heeding many able advisers. He kept his door open to the humble and never blocked access, yet even then some voices below never reached him.

manualTranslations.zh: 今陛下新即位，所信用者何人？
manualTranslations.literal: Now Your Majesty has newly ascended the throne—whom do you trust?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has only just taken the throne—whom do you trust?"

manualTranslations.zh: 奈何頓與臣下隔絕！
manualTranslations.literal: Why suddenly cut yourself off from your ministers!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why cut yourself off from your ministers all at once!

manualTranslations.zh: 臣老即死，恐無復一見顏色。」
manualTranslations.literal: When this old man dies, I fear I shall never again see your face."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I am old and shall soon die, and I fear I shall never see your face again."

manualTranslations.zh: 因泣下嗚咽，景為之動容，引與坐，賜食而慰之，遂寢所下令。
manualTranslations.literal: He wept and sobbed. Jing was moved, drew him in to sit, bestowed food and comforted him, and thereupon withdrew the order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He wept aloud. Jing was moved, had him sit, gave him food and comfort, and withdrew the order.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，宋齊丘為昪謀篡楊氏最有力，及事成，乃陽入九華山，昪屢招之，乃出。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Song Qiqiu had been most forceful in plotting for Bian to usurp the Yang clan. When the deed was done he pretended to enter Jiuhua Mountain; repeatedly summoned by Bian, he then came out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song Qiqiu had been the strongest advocate of Bian's overthrow of the Yang house. Once the deed was done he pretended to retire to Jiuhua Mountain, but repeated summons from Bian brought him back to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 昪僭號，未幾，齊丘以病罷相，出為洪州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Bian assumed the imperial title, before long Qiqiu was dismissed from the chancellorship on grounds of illness and went out as military governor of Hong Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Not long after Bian took the imperial title, Qiqiu resigned the chancellorship on grounds of illness and became military governor of Hongzhou.

sourceRange.text: 交泰元年正月，大赦改元。周師攻楚州，守將張彥卿、鄭昭業城守甚堅，攻四十日不可破。世宗親督兵以洞屋穴城而焚之，城壞，彥卿、昭業戰死，周兵怒甚，殺戮殆盡。周師復取海、泰、揚州。世宗幸迎鑾以臨大江，景知不能支，而恥自屈身去其名號，乃遣陳覺奉表，請傳國與其世子而聽命。

context.beforeSource: 十二月，屯于楚州之北門。
context.afterSource: 初，周師南征，無水戰之具，已而屢敗景兵，獲水戰卒，乃造戰艦數百艘，使降卒教之水戰，命王環將以下淮。

manualTranslations.zh: 交泰元年正月，大赦改元。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jiaotai there was a general amnesty and the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jiaotai 1 a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.zh: 周師攻楚州，守將張彥卿、鄭昭業城守甚堅，攻四十日不可破。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou troops attacked Chuzhou. The defending generals Zhang Yanqing and Zheng Zhaoye held the city very firmly; for forty days of assault it could not be taken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou forces laid siege to Chuzhou. The defenders Zhang Yanqing and Zheng Zhaoye held the walls with grim tenacity, and forty days of assault failed to break them.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗親督兵以洞屋穴城而焚之，城壞，彥卿、昭業戰死，周兵怒甚，殺戮殆盡。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizong personally directed troops to tunnel under the city with covered galleries, burn it, and break the walls. The city fell; Yanqing and Zhaoye died in battle. The Zhou soldiers were greatly enraged and slaughtered nearly everyone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizong personally directed sappers to tunnel under the walls with covered galleries and set the city ablaze. When the walls gave way, Yanqing and Zhaoye fell fighting. Enraged Zhou troops slaughtered nearly the entire population.

manualTranslations.zh: 周師復取海、泰、揚州。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou troops again took Hai, Tai, and Yang prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Zhou army then recovered Haizhou, Taizhou, and Yangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗幸迎鑾以臨大江，景知不能支，而恥自屈身去其名號，乃遣陳覺奉表，請傳國與其世子而聽命。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizong proceeded to Yingluan to overlook the Great River. Jing knew he could not hold out, yet was ashamed to humble himself and abandon his title; he therefore sent Chen Jue with a memorial requesting to transmit the state to his heir and await orders.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizong went to Yingluan to face the Yangtze. Li Jing knew he could not hold out, yet shrank from humbling himself and surrendering his title. He sent Chen Jue with a memorial offering to pass the realm to his heir and await Zhou commands.

manualTranslations.zh: 光啟元年，河中王重榮與令孜爭鹽池，重榮召晉兵犯京師，僖宗幸鳳翔。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Guangqi, Wang Chongrong of Hezhong disputed the salt pools with Lingzi; Chongrong summoned Jin troops to violate the capital, and Xizong went to Fengxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Guangqi 1, Hezhong's Wang Chongrong quarreled with Lingzi over the salt pools, summoned Jin troops against the capital, and Xizong fled to Fengxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年三月，移幸興元，以建為清道使，負玉璽以從。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the second year the court moved to Xingyuan; Jian was made Clear-Path Commissioner and carried the jade seal in attendance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 2 the court moved to Xingyuan, appointed Jian Clear-Path Commissioner, and had him carry the jade seal in attendance.

manualTranslations.zh: 行至當塗驛，李昌符焚棧道，棧道幾斷，建控僖宗馬，冒煙燄中過，宿坂下，僖宗枕建膝寢，既覺，涕泣，解御衣賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: When they reached Dangtu Post, Li Changfu burned the plank road and the road was nearly cut; Jian held Xizong's horse and passed through the smoke and flames, lodging below the slope. Xizong slept with his head on Jian's knee; when he awoke he wept, removed his imperial robe, and bestowed it on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Dangtu Post, Li Changfu burned the plank road and nearly severed it. Jian held Xizong's horse and led him through smoke and flame, then lodged below the slope. Xizong slept with his head on Jian's knee; when he awoke he wept, took off his imperial robe, and gave it to Jian.

sourceRange.text: 」故建待格等恩禮尤異，其餘宋玭等百餘人，並見信用。武成元年正月，祀天南郊，大赦，改元，以王宗佶為太師。宗佶本姓甘氏，建為忠武軍卒時掠得之，養以為子，後以軍功累遷武信軍節度使。後建所生子元懿等稍長，宗佶以養子心不自安，與鄭騫等謀，求為大司馬，總六軍，開元帥府，凡軍事便宜行而後聞。建以宗佶創業功多，優容之。唐襲本以舞僮見幸於建，宗佶尤易之，後為樞密使，猶名呼襲，襲雖內恨，而外奉宗佶愈謹。建聞之，怒曰：「宗佶名呼我樞密使，是將反也。」宗佶求大司馬，章三上，建以問襲，襲因激怒建曰：「宗佶功臣，其威望可以服人心，陛下宜即與之。」建心益疑。宗佶入奏事，自請不已，建叱衞士撲殺之，并賜騫死。六月，以遂王宗懿為皇太子。建加尊號英武睿聖皇帝。七月，騶虞見武定。

localRange.text: 故建待格等恩禮尤異，其餘宋比等百餘人，並見信用。

context.beforeSource: 建謂左右曰：「吾為神策軍將時，宿衞禁中，見天子夜召學士，出入無間，恩禮親厚如寮友，非將相可比也。
context.afterSource: 二年，頒永昌曆。

context.afterLocal: 二年，頒《永昌曆》。

manualTranslations.zh: 故建待格等恩禮尤異，其餘宋玭等百餘人，並見信用。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore Jian treated Ge and the others with especially unusual favor; the rest, more than a hundred men including Song Pin, were all trusted and employed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For that reason he treated Ge and the others with exceptional favor, and more than a hundred others, including Song Pin, were all trusted and employed.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成元年正月，祀天南郊，大赦，改元，以王宗佶為太師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Wucheng he sacrificed to Heaven at the southern suburb, proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the era name, and made Wang Zongji Grand Preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Wucheng 1 he sacrificed to Heaven at the southern suburb, proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the era name, and made Wang Zongji grand preceptor.

manualTranslations.zh: 宗佶本姓甘氏，建為忠武軍卒時掠得之，養以為子，後以軍功累遷武信軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: Zongji was originally of the Gan clan; when Jian was a Zhongwu Army soldier he seized him and raised him as a son, and later through military merit he was repeatedly promoted to Wuxin military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zongji was originally a Gan. Jian had seized him as a Zhongwu soldier and raised him as a son; through military merit he rose to Wuxin military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 後建所生子元懿等稍長，宗佶以養子心不自安，與鄭騫等謀，求為大司馬，總六軍，開元帥府，凡軍事便宜行而後聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, when Jian's own sons Yuanyi and the others grew up, Zongji as an adopted son felt ill at ease in his heart. With Zheng Qian and others he plotted to seek appointment as Grand Marshal, command the Six Armies, open a commander-in-chief's headquarters, and handle all military affairs at discretion and report afterward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jian's own sons Yuanyi and the others grew up, the adopted Zongji grew uneasy. With Zheng Qian and others he sought appointment as grand marshal, command of the Six Armies, and a commander-in-chief's headquarters with discretionary military authority.

manualTranslations.zh: 建以宗佶創業功多，優容之。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian, because Zongji had much merit in founding the state, indulged him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Zongji had done much to build the state, Jian indulged him.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐襲本以舞僮見幸於建，宗佶尤易之，後為樞密使，猶名呼襲，襲雖內恨，而外奉宗佶愈謹。
manualTranslations.literal: Tang Xi had originally been favored by Jian as a dancing boy; Zongji especially looked down on him. Later made commissioner of palace secrets, he still called Xi by name. Xi inwardly resented this but outwardly served Zongji all the more deferentially.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tang Xi had first won Jian's favor as a dancing boy, and Zongji especially despised him. Even after Xi became commissioner of palace secrets, Zongji still called him by name. Xi hated it inwardly but served Zongji all the more deferentially on the surface.

manualTranslations.zh: 建聞之，怒曰：「宗佶名呼我樞密使，是將反也。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jian heard of it he angrily said: "Zongji calls my commissioner of palace secrets by name—he is about to rebel."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jian heard of it he raged: "Zongji calls my commissioner of palace secrets by name—that means he is plotting rebellion."

manualTranslations.zh: 」宗佶求大司馬，章三上，建以問襲，襲因激怒建曰：「宗佶功臣，其威望可以服人心，陛下宜即與之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zongji petitioned for Grand Marshal three times. Jian asked Xi about it, and Xi inflamed Jian, saying: "Zongji is a founding minister whose prestige can win men's hearts. Your Majesty ought to grant it at once."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zongji petitioned three times for grand marshal. Jian asked Xi, and Xi goaded him on: "Zongji is a founding minister whose prestige can win hearts. Your Majesty should grant it at once."

manualTranslations.zh: 」建心益疑。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian's suspicions grew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian grew still more suspicious.

manualTranslations.zh: 宗佶入奏事，自請不已，建叱衞士撲殺之，并賜騫死。
manualTranslations.literal: Zongji entered to report affairs and kept pressing his request. Jian ordered the guards to beat him to death and also had Qian executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zongji came in to report and kept pressing his request. Jian ordered the guards to beat him to death and had Qian executed as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，以遂王宗懿為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month he made Prince of Sui Zongyi crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he made Prince Zongyi of Sui crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 建加尊號英武睿聖皇帝。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian added the honorific title Emperor Yingwu Ruisheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian took the honorific title Emperor Yingwu Ruisheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，騶虞見武定。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month a zouyu appeared in Wuding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month a zouyu appeared in Wuding.

sourceRange.text: 詩曰：「吁嗟乎騶虞！

context.beforeSource: 騶虞，吾不知其何物也。
context.afterSource: 」賈誼以謂騶者，文王之囿；
context.beforeLocal: 騶虞，吾不知其何物也。

sourceRange.text: 光天元年六月，建卒，年七十二。建晚年多內寵，賢妃徐氏與妹淑妃，皆以色進，專房用事，交結宦者唐文扆等干與外政。建年老昏耄，文扆判六軍，事無大小，皆決文扆。及建疾，以兵入宿衞，謀盡去建故將。故將聞建疾，皆不得入見，久之，宗弼等排闥入，言文扆欲為變，乃殺之。建因以老將大臣多許昌故人，必不為太子用，思擇人未得而疾亟，乃以宦者宋光嗣為樞密使判六軍而建卒。太子立，去「宗」名衍。

context.beforeSource: 十二月，大赦，改明年元曰光天，復國號蜀。
context.afterSource: 衍字化源。
context.beforeLocal: 十二月，大赦，改明年元曰光天，復國號蜀。
context.afterLocal: 衍字化源。

manualTranslations.zh: 光天元年六月，建卒，年七十二。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Guangtian Jian died at seventy-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Guangtian 1, Jian died at seventy-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 建晚年多內寵，賢妃徐氏與妹淑妃，皆以色進，專房用事，交結宦者唐文扆等干與外政。
manualTranslations.literal: In his later years Jian had many inner favorites. Consort Xu the Worthy and her younger sister the Pure Consort, all advanced by beauty, monopolized the inner quarters and handled affairs, associating with the eunuch Tang Wenyi and others to meddle in external government.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In his later years Jian kept many inner favorites. Consort Xu the Worthy and her younger sister the Pure Consort, advanced by beauty, monopolized the inner quarters and joined eunuchs such as Tang Wenyi in meddling in state affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 建年老昏耄，文扆判六軍，事無大小，皆決文扆。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian in old age was senile; Wenyi adjudicated the Six Armies, and matters great and small were all decided by Wenyi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Jian aged into senility, Wenyi adjudicated the Six Armies and decided every matter, large or small.

manualTranslations.zh: 及建疾，以兵入宿衞，謀盡去建故將。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jian fell ill, Wenyi brought troops into palace guard duty and plotted to remove all of Jian's old generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jian fell ill, Wenyi brought troops into palace guard duty and plotted to purge all of Jian's old generals.

manualTranslations.zh: 故將聞建疾，皆不得入見，久之，宗弼等排闥入，言文扆欲為變，乃殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the old generals heard Jian was ill they were all barred from audience. After a long while Zongbi and others forced the door and entered, saying Wenyi intended rebellion, and killed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The old generals heard Jian was ill but were barred from seeing him. At length Zongbi and others forced their way in, declared Wenyi was plotting rebellion, and killed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 建因以老將大臣多許昌故人，必不為太子用，思擇人未得而疾亟，乃以宦者宋光嗣為樞密使判六軍而建卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian, because many of the old generals and senior ministers were old associates from Xuchang and would surely not serve the crown prince, wished to choose someone but had not yet done so when his illness grew urgent; he therefore made the eunuch Song Guangsi commissioner of palace secrets with concurrent adjudication of the Six Armies, and then Jian died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian knew many old generals and ministers were Xuchang associates who would not serve the crown prince. He sought another choice but had not found one when his illness turned critical; he made the eunuch Song Guangsi commissioner of palace secrets with concurrent command of the Six Armies, and then died.

manualTranslations.zh: 太子立，去「宗」名衍。
manualTranslations.literal: When the crown prince succeeded he dropped the character "Zong" and was named Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the crown prince succeeded he dropped the character Zong and took the name Yan.

sourceRange.text: 是時，鳳翔李茂貞兼據梁、洋、秦、隴，數以兵侵建。天復元年，梁太祖兵誅宦者，宦者韓全誨等劫天子幸鳳翔，梁兵圍之，茂貞閉城拒守經年，力窘，求與梁和。建間遣人聘茂貞，許以出兵為援，勸其堅壁勿和。遣王宗滌將兵五萬，聲言迎駕，以攻興元，執其節度使李繼業，而武定節度使拓拔思敬遂以其地降于建，於是并有山南西道。是時，荊南成汭死，襄州趙匡凝遣其弟匡明襲據之，建乘其間，攻下夔、施、忠、萬四州。三年八月，唐封建蜀王。四年，唐遷都洛陽，改元天祐，建與唐隔絕而不知，故仍稱天復。六年，又取歸州，於是并有三峽。

context.beforeSource: 建以王宗滌為東川留後，唐即以宗滌為節度使，於是并有兩川之地。
context.afterSource: 七年，梁滅唐，遣使者諭建，建拒而不納。
context.beforeLocal: 建以王宗滌為東川留後，唐即以宗滌為節度使，於是並有兩川之地。
context.afterLocal: 七年，梁滅唐，遣使者諭建，建拒而不納。

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，鳳翔李茂貞兼據梁、洋、秦、隴，數以兵侵建。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Li Maozhen of Fengxiang held Liang, Yang, Qin, and Long together and repeatedly sent troops against Jian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Li Maozhen of Fengxiang held Liang, Yang, Qin, and Long and repeatedly attacked Jian.

manualTranslations.zh: 天復元年，梁太祖兵誅宦者，宦者韓全誨等劫天子幸鳳翔，梁兵圍之，茂貞閉城拒守經年，力窘，求與梁和。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianfu the Liang founder used troops to execute the eunuchs; the eunuchs Han Quanhui and others seized the Son of Heaven and went to Fengxiang. Liang troops besieged the city; Maozhen shut the gates and held out for a year, then in straits sought peace with Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianfu 1 the Liang founder moved against the eunuchs. Han Quanhui and other eunuchs seized the emperor and fled to Fengxiang. Liang besieged the city; Maozhen held out for a year, then exhausted, sought peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 建間遣人聘茂貞，許以出兵為援，勸其堅壁勿和。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian secretly sent envoys to Maozhen, promising to march out in relief and urging him to hold the walls and not make peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian secretly sent envoys to Maozhen, promising relief and urging him to hold firm and refuse peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣王宗滌將兵五萬，聲言迎駕，以攻興元，執其節度使李繼業，而武定節度使拓拔思敬遂以其地降于建，於是并有山南西道。
manualTranslations.literal: He sent Wang Zongti with fifty thousand troops, claiming to welcome the imperial carriage, to attack Xingyuan, seize its military commissioner Li Jiye, and Wuding military commissioner Tuoba Sijing then surrendered his territory to Jian; Jian thereby held the Western Shannan Circuit as well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent Wang Zongti with fifty thousand men, claiming to welcome the emperor, against Xingyuan, captured its commissioner Li Jiye, and Wuding commissioner Tuoba Sijing surrendered to Jian. Jian now held Western Shannan as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，荊南成汭死，襄州趙匡凝遣其弟匡明襲據之，建乘其間，攻下夔、施、忠、萬四州。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Cheng Run of Jingnan died; Zhao Kuangning of Xiangzhou sent his younger brother Kuangming to seize and hold the region. Jian took advantage of the moment and captured the four prefectures of Kui, Shi, Zhong, and Wan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cheng Run of Jingnan died; Zhao Kuangning of Xiangzhou sent his brother Kuangming to seize the region. Jian seized the moment and took Kui, Shi, Zhong, and Wan.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年八月，唐封建蜀王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year Tang enfeoffed Jian as Prince of Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 3, Tang enfeoffed Jian as Prince of Shu.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，唐遷都洛陽，改元天祐，建與唐隔絕而不知，故仍稱天復。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year Tang moved the capital to Luoyang and changed the era name to Tianyou; Jian was cut off from Tang and did not know, so he still used Tianfu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 4 Tang moved the capital to Luoyang and renamed the era Tianyou. Cut off from Tang, Jian did not know and still used Tianfu.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，又取歸州，於是并有三峽。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he also took Guizhou, and thereby held all Three Gorges as well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 6 he also took Guizhou and now held all Three Gorges.

sourceRange.text: 東川顧彥朗與建有舊，建聞令孜召己，大喜，因至梓州，謂彥朗曰：「十軍阿父召我，我欲至成都見陳公，以求一鎮。」即以其家屬託彥朗，選精兵二千，馳之成都。行至鹿頭關，敬瑄悔召建，使人止之。建大怒，擊破鹿頭關，取漢州。彥朗聞之，出兵助建，軍于學射。敬瑄遣將句惟立逆建，建擊敗之，遂攻彭州。敬瑄遣眉州刺史山行章將兵五萬屯新繁，建又擊敗之，虜獲萬餘人，橫屍四十里。敬瑄發兵七萬益行章，與建相持濛陽、新都百餘日。昭宗遣左諫議大夫李洵為兩川宣諭和協使，詔彥朗等罷兵。彥朗請以大臣鎮蜀，因為建求旌節。文德元年六月，以宰相韋昭度為西川節度使。分邛、蜀、黎、雅為永平軍，拜建節度使。

context.beforeSource: 」乃使人招建。
context.afterSource: 敬瑄不受代，昭宗即命昭度將彥朗等兵討之。
context.beforeLocal: 乃使人招建。
context.afterLocal: 敬瑄不受代，昭宗即命昭度將彥朗等兵討之。

manualTranslations.zh: 東川顧彥朗與建有舊，建聞令孜召己，大喜，因至梓州，謂彥朗曰：「十軍阿父召我，我欲至成都見陳公，以求一鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: Gu Yanlang of Dongchuan was old friends with Jian. When Jian heard that Lingzi had summoned him he was greatly pleased, went to Zizhou, and told Yanlang: "The Shidian adoptive father has summoned me. I wish to go to Chengdu to see Lord Chen and seek a commandery."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gu Yanlang of Dongchuan was an old acquaintance of Jian. When Jian heard Lingzi had summoned him he was delighted, went to Zizhou, and told Yanlang, "My Shidian adoptive father has called me. I mean to go to Chengdu to see Lord Chen and win a prefecture."

manualTranslations.zh: 」即以其家屬託彥朗，選精兵二千，馳之成都。
manualTranslations.literal: He thereupon entrusted his family to Yanlang, selected two thousand picked troops, and galloped to Chengdu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entrusted his family to Yanlang, chose two thousand elite troops, and raced to Chengdu.

manualTranslations.zh: 行至鹿頭關，敬瑄悔召建，使人止之。
manualTranslations.literal: When he reached Lutou Pass, Jingxuan regretted summoning Jian and sent men to stop him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Lutou Pass, Jingxuan regretted summoning Jian and sent men to halt him.

manualTranslations.zh: 建大怒，擊破鹿頭關，取漢州。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian was furious, stormed Lutou Pass, and took Han Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian flew into a rage, broke through Lutou Pass, and seized Han Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 彥朗聞之，出兵助建，軍于學射。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yanlang heard of it he sent troops to aid Jian and encamped at Xueshe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanlang heard and marched to help Jian, encamping at Xueshe.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬瑄遣將句惟立逆建，建擊敗之，遂攻彭州。
manualTranslations.literal: Jingxuan sent the general Gou Weili to oppose Jian; Jian defeated him and then attacked Peng Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingxuan sent Gou Weili against Jian. Jian routed him and attacked Peng Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬瑄遣眉州刺史山行章將兵五萬屯新繁，建又擊敗之，虜獲萬餘人，橫屍四十里。
manualTranslations.literal: Jingxuan sent Meizhou Prefect Shan Xingzhang with fifty thousand troops to encamp at Xinfan; Jian again defeated him, capturing more than ten thousand men, and corpses lay across forty li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingxuan sent Meizhou prefect Shan Xingzhang with fifty thousand men to hold Xinfan. Jian defeated him again, took more than ten thousand captives, and left corpses strewn for forty li.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬瑄發兵七萬益行章，與建相持濛陽、新都百餘日。
manualTranslations.literal: Jingxuan sent seventy thousand more troops to reinforce Xingzhang, and he and Jian faced each other at Mengyang and Xindu for more than a hundred days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingxuan sent seventy thousand reinforcements to Xingzhang, and the two sides stalemate at Mengyang and Xindu for more than a hundred days.

manualTranslations.zh: 昭宗遣左諫議大夫李洵為兩川宣諭和協使，詔彥朗等罷兵。

sourceRange.text: 天成二年，請建行臺。明宗封殷楚國王，有司言無封國王禮，請如三公用竹冊，乃遣尚書右丞李序持節以竹冊封之。殷以潭州為長沙府，建國承制，自置官屬，以其弟賨為靜江軍節度使，子希振武順軍節度使，次子希聲判內外諸軍事，姚彥章為左相，許德勳為右相，李鐸為司徒，崔穎為司空，拓拔常為僕射，馬珙為尚書，文武皆進位。謚其曾祖筠曰文肅、祖正曰莊穆、父元豐曰景莊，立三廟于長沙。長興元年，殷卒，年七十九，詔曰「馬殷官爵俱高，無以為贈，謚曰武穆」而已。子希聲立。希聲字若訥，殷次子也。殷建國，以希聲判內外諸軍事。荊南高季昌聞殷將高郁素教殷以計策而楚以彊，患之，嘗使諜者行間於殷，殷不聽。希聲用事，諜者語希聲曰：「季昌聞楚用高郁，大喜，以為亡馬氏者必郁也。」希聲素愚，以為然，遽奪郁兵職，郁怒曰：「吾事君王久矣，亟營西山，將老焉，犬子漸大，能咋人矣！」希聲聞之，矯殷令殺郁。殷老不復省事，莫知郁死，是日大霧四塞，殷怪之，語左右曰：「吾嘗從孫儒，儒每殺不辜，天必大霧，豈馬步獄有冤死乎？」明日，吏以狀白，殷拊膺大哭曰：「吾荒耄如此，而殺吾勳舊！」顧左右曰：「吾亦不久於此矣！」明年殷薨。

context.beforeSource: 由是地大力完，數邀封爵。
context.afterSource: 希聲立，授武安、靜江等軍節度使。
